description: Reverse lookup: which Safes this address co-controls (is an owner/signer of). Without `details` it returns a FREE Ethereum-only count (teaser). With `details:true` it returns the full breakdown across all supported chains including the Safe addresses - paid per-use via x402 (USDC on Polygon); auto-pays if REPUTA_PAYER_PRIVATE_KEY is set.

details.description: false (default) = free Ethereum-only count. true = paid full breakdown across all chains.

name: reputa_safe_owner
